# Wordle Bot

Curated by Skill Harbor — a small, honest automation for Wordle fans: it runs the strategy of solving dated NYT Wordle puzzles programmatically and emitting the classic emoji grid for sharing. A genuinely local, self-contained skill — Python plus a package install, no accounts, no APIs — that does one thing: applies a solving strategy to the puzzle of a given date and shows you the result the way Wordle players share it. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @fkodom. Honest caveats: it solves, so using it on today's puzzle is a spoiler, not a challenge — best for archives, stats, or curiosity; requires Python and installing its packages on your machine; Wordle's puzzle source could change and break the fetch. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
